description: Source code implementing Unicode code point validation and UTF encoding/decoding functions in the BoringSSL library.

methods.name: is_valid_code_point
methods.description: Checks if a Unicode code point is valid based on Unicode 9.0.0 standards.

methods.name: cbs_get_utf8
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-8 encoded character from CBS buffer.

methods.name: cbs_get_latin1
methods.description: Decodes a Latin-1 character from CBS buffer.

methods.name: cbs_get_ucs2_be
methods.description: Decodes a UCS-2 big-endian character from CBS buffer.

methods.name: cbs_get_utf32_be
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-32 big-endian character from CBS buffer.

methods.name: cbb_get_utf8_len
methods.description: Calculates the length in bytes of a UTF-8 encoding for a given code point.

methods.name: cbb_add_utf8
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 and adds it to CBB buffer.

methods.name: cbb_add_latin1
methods.description: Encodes a Latin-1 code point into a CBB buffer.

methods.name: cbb_add_ucs2_be
methods.description: Encodes a code point into UCS-2 big-endian format and adds to CBB buffer.

methods.name: cbb_add_utf32_be
methods.description: Encodes a code point into UTF-32 big-endian format and adds to CBB buffer.
